rationale: Both Vadym and Ayush are blockchain-focused CEOs building in the crypto space. intro_message: Vadym Hrusha, meet Ayush Panchmiya — both are blockchain-focused founders and CEOs who may benefit from exploring how your respective approaches to crypto and blockchain align.
